parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the container cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~182997~~) operation to query the IDs of container clusters.

parameters.name: DstTarget
parameters.description:
The destination objects of the rule. The following parameters are included:

*   targetId: the ID of the destination object. You can call the [ListInterceptionTargetPage](~~ListInterceptionTargetPage~~) operation to query the ID.
*   ports: the destination port ranges.

parameters.name: InterceptType
parameters.description:
The interception mode. Valid values:

*   **1**: block
*   **2**: alert
*   **3**: allow

parameters.name: OrderIndex
parameters.description: The priority of the rule. Valid values: 1 to 1000. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: RuleSwitch
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the rule is enabled. Valid values:

*   **1**: enabled
*   **0**: disabled

parameters.name: SrcTarget
parameters.description:
The source object of the rule. The following parameters are included:

*   targetId: the ID of the source object. You can call the [ListInterceptionTargetPage](~~ListInterceptionTargetPage~~) operation to query the ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-interception-rule --rule-id 500018 --cluster-id c17ef568f81884cdab402decd5fcd0000 --rule-name tetsRule --rule-switch 1 --src-target targetId=400989 --dst-target targetId=600069 ports=["80/8088"] --intercept-type 1 --order-index 1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ModifyInterceptionRule --region cn-hangzhou --RuleSwitch 1 --ClusterId c17ef568f81884cdab402decd5fcd0000 --InterceptType 1 --RuleId 500018 --SrcTarget '{"targetId":400989}' --OrderIndex 1 --DstTarget '{"targetId":600069,"ports":["80/8088"]}' --RuleName tetsRule
